summary: First MVP testing run for NileNest. Backend: 32/32 pytest cases passed covering auth, catalog, journal, cart, coupons, checkout (MOCK), orders, admin RBAC, admin order lifecycle (PLACED→PACKED→SHIPPED→DELIVERED), admin CRUD (coupons, articles, product stock_state recompute), audit log, AI recommend (Gemini), AI chat SSE streaming, and SEO sitemap/robots. Frontend smoke via Playwright: Home hero + 2 featured products render, Shop grid loads with 2 products, PDP renders title/price for daily-vitality-herbal-tea, Add-to-Cart opens the CartDrawer with a working checkout button, Checkout page renders address form + place order, Login with admin credentials redirects to /admin and all admin tabs (dashboard/orders/catalog/promotions/audit) are clickable, AI FAB opens the concierge widget and streams a coherent response grounded on the catalog.

minor.issue: orders_today filter compares full ISO datetime string ($gte today-date-only). Works but brittle across timezones — recommend storing/querying a normalized date field.
Every anonymous GET creates a new empty cart in Mongo when no cart_id is supplied — over time this can pollute the carts collection. Consider only creating on first item add.
Stock decrement + re-read of the product is done in a per-item loop without a transaction/atomic guard; concurrent orders could over-sell. For MVP acceptable, flagging for post-launch.

issues: React warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (shadcn Dialog). Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to silence a11y warning.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the AIChat DialogContent to remove a11y console warning.
(Post-launch) Harden checkout stock decrement with an atomic Mongo update guard against over-selling.
(Post-launch) Avoid inserting an empty cart on every anonymous GET /api/cart call.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 1322-line file — split into modules (auth, catalog, cart, checkout, admin, ai, seo, seed) for maintainability once MVP is stable.
AI SSE endpoint yields error text into the same `data:` frame on exception. Consider emitting an explicit `event: error` so clients can distinguish transient failures.
apply_coupon returns rupee amount in the min_subtotal error message using coupon['min_subtotal'] which may render as '499.0' — cast to int for user-facing string.
Product listing min_price/max_price filter only inspects variants[0]; multi-variant products may be filtered incorrectly. Consider checking any variant.
test_credentials: admin@nilenest.in / NileNest@2026 (admin), editor@nilenest.in / NileNest@2026 (editor). Customers registered dynamically via /api/auth/register during tests.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed created — startup seeder populated 2 categories, 2 products, 3 articles, 3 coupons (WELCOME10, FREESHIP, FIRSTBLOOM), admin+editor users, and homepage CMS block on first boot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is a full regression suite. Run with: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -o addopts='' --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. It self-loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Session-scoped fixtures create a fresh customer per run and drive a full commerce+admin lifecycle. AI tests use live Gemini via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (fallback path is acceptable). The order-lifecycle test transitions one order through DELIVERED, so downstream tests must not assume PLACED state.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
